objective: Synthesize the verified/scar-bearing DiGe C/H lineage into one source-level internal S1 human-system candidate using the canonical DEUS prototypes as evaluator/engineering targets, not as pixels or external image-generation inputs.

prototype_inputs.step02: continuous mesh + surface blockout / unified topology / silhouette continuity
prototype_inputs.step04: face + hands articulation / eyelid-jaw-lips interfaces / neutral pose
prototype_inputs.step06: cloth layer + deformation / tank top + leggings / body contact
prototype_inputs.step07: hair strand system + groom / layered bun / scalp flow / flyaways
prototype_inputs.step09: PBR skin + cloth + area lighting / material response

synthesis_rules: Identity/body stays deterministic source-level geometry; no image-space identity repair.
H-line contributes locality and artifact-avoidance principles only; no H image pixels are composited.
Eyes use native GNM geometry with topology-independent generated-coordinate iris/pupil and real cornea/wetline interfaces.
Skin uses actual GNM face material with restrained SSS, regional roughness, meso/pore/micro normal; semantic UV nearest-transfer is forbidden.
Hair uses scalp-rooted layered system: dark scalp coverage mass + dense thin tangential undercoat + deep gather + rounded bun + sparse baby/flyaway layers; long01 is not a final-style prior.
Cloth becomes explicit gray tank + gray leggings source-level shell with procedural fabric PBR; helper body-suit is not final presentation.
Camera contract: 50mm full-body multiview + 85mm portrait hero; same subject origin/scale.
Studio area lighting must reveal material response without beauty-patch postprocess.
Hands remain neutral/rest in S1; no articulation-range claim unless separately executed.

runtime_gate.device: CPU unless a fresh admitted GPU receipt exists

visual_gate: hairline continuous and irregular, no comb/radial spike/helmet artifact
eyes embedded in lids with readable iris/pupil and restrained sclera
skin visibly material-responsive with pores/meso detail without plastic/chalk read
tank/leggings read as fabric and follow body without full-body helper-suit look
full-body silhouette and ground contact remain plausible
truth_boundary: S1 is endogenous only if renderer receipts show zero external image generation and zero reference-pixel read/composite. Runtime PASS does not equal visual PASS or hyperreal certification.
